name: Zibuyu Group Limited
summary: Zibuyu Group Limited, an investment holding company, operates as a cross-border e-commerce company in China in North America, Asia, Europe, and internationally. The company offers women's clothing, men's clothing, sports, children's clothing, women's shoes, footwear, and other products. It also provides clothing and footwear products under the Rich Radi Q's, Cicy Bell, Coutgo, Runcati, Wenrine, Fisov, Tankaneo, Saodimallsu, Yousify, and haloumoning brand names.
